first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Adult man with short brown hair combed back and a relatively high hairline, wearing a black suit jacket, white shirt, and dark tie.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: A rough grayish-brown wall surface behind the wooden components; in the latter half, irregular stones, joints, and localized light-colored plaster are visible.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: A dark architectural structure comprising wooden stair treads, thick vertical posts, horizontal beams, and diagonal components.

entities.name: Reddish-brown plane at the far end
entities.identification: A dark reddish-brown surface deep within the Central vertical shaft opening, with rows of rectangular sections and joints.

entities.name: Central vertical shaft opening
entities.identification: A dark, nearly square central space enclosed by the wooden stairs and post-and-beam frame, with downward layers that progressively narrow with depth.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: A vertical, lightly illuminated opening in the side wall, more fully visible on the right and occluded by the wooden structure on the left.
